deployments_detail.use: AI to accelerate critical-metal deposit discovery with BRGM and Lithosquare plus AI on metallurgical furnaces
Visual AI for nickel mine operations optimization [Alteia]
AI for critical minerals exploration in Africa
Predictive maintenance for mining equipment and furnace operations [Capgemini Invent]
Visual/vision AI on the Tiebaghi nickel mine (SLN, New Caledonia) correlating truck telematics, LiDAR 3D digital twins and haul-road surface analysis to optimize tire wear and fuel use [Alteia]
deployments_detail.value: 30% reduction in haul-truck tire maintenance cost, 15% reduction in fuel consumption, 10x faster data processing

deployments_detail.use: Integrated Remote Operations Center (IROC) using AI/ML for real-time monitoring and decision support across the group's global mining operations

Predictive maintenance for the 650 km Transgabonais railway (Setrag, Gabon): a sensor-equipped maintenance locomotive collects rail-gap and track-shape data to forecast track degradation kilometer by kilometer

AI algorithms optimizing high-temperature pyrometallurgical furnaces in Norway and New Caledonia, giving metallurgists predictive recommendations on production quality, energy efficiency and economic performance for manganese/nickel alloys [Capgemini Invent]

Picterra GeoAI platform for mineral exploration target evaluation, geotechnical stability/risk analysis, and water-body detection around mining sites; integrates with ESRI ArcGIS and satellite imagery [Picterra]

Framework partnership applying Lithosquare's proprietary geological/foundational AI to combine historical and recent geological data with BRGM archives to rank and accelerate discovery of critical-metal deposits, initially in Africa [Lithosquare, BRGM]
Computer-vision system on Setrag (Gabon) surveillance cameras detecting train arrival, wagon count and ore-loading levels to automate arrival-time evaluation and operational planning
Sensor + AI analysis on mining equipment/vehicles at Comilog (Gabon) monitoring fuel consumption, maintenance-schedule compliance and speed-limit adherence
AI/data-science models at Erasteel (Sweden) to optimize and shorten the lead time required to deliver high-performance steels to customers [Capgemini Invent]

'Connected Concession' application at GCO Senegal using drone imagery and geospatial AI to automatically detect buildings, trees, shafts and fields to accelerate and monitor land rehabilitation and environmental impact [Capgemini]
